project_type: C11 language runtime with built-in stdlib packages
build_system: Makefile with clang, auto-discovers src/*.c via wildcard
test_framework: Custom C test harness (test_*.c with TEST/ASSERT macros) + integration tests (.ve files with .expected outputs)
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'make clean && make' to verify build. 2. Run 'make test' to run all unit and integration tests. 3. All tests should pass with 0 failures.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Linux x86_64. clang available. No external C libraries except system libc, libm, libpthread, libdl, and vendored sqlite3.c.
contribution_requirements: Each stdlib package is a single src/stdlib_<name>.c file. Must be registered in src/vek_stdlib.c and src/vek_stdlib.h. Use NativeFn signature: Value fn(int argc, Value* args). Use create_package() pattern. GC safety: gc_push_root/gc_pop_root around allocations.
key_patterns: 1. Each package: stdlib_<name>_init(ObjMap* pkg) function. 2. Register natives with stdlib_register(pkg, name, fn, arity). 3. arity=-1 for variadic. 4. Return VAL_NIL on error, OBJ_VAL(string) for strings, INT_VAL for ints, VAL_TRUE/VAL_FALSE for bools. 5. Use IS_STRING/AS_STRING macros to check/cast args. 6. ObjMap for returning structured data (like db rows). 7. Static global state for per-package state. 8. Pin objects that must survive GC with vm_pin().
directory_structure: src/ - all C source files (stdlib_*.c, vm.c, gc.c, etc.). tests/ - unit tests (test_*.c) and integration tests (programs/*.ve + *.expected). build/ - compiled output. Makefile at root.
